text_1312175923.text: Shoulder iD Primary Reversed Glenoid is powered by Stryker’s Blueprint technology, an advanced surgical planning software that allows the surgeon to plan a personalized implant for each patient’s unique anatomy. Shoulder iD is created to be more patient-specific than ever before.

largeheadline.line1: With Shoulder iD, visualize, plan, and order your patient's unique glenoid implant directly through Blueprint 3D planning software.

text_copy.text:
Patient-matched to meet your patient’s unique anatomy 


Surgeon driven — no engineering meetings to build augment 


Patient-specific instrumentation models the native glenoid and guides pin placement 


Manual Bone Prep feature allows osteophyte removal without sacrificing the patient-matched augment


Personalized lateralization — fine-tune the degree of glenoid lateralization for desired deformity correction

largeheadline.line1: Learn how surgeons are using Shoulder iD as an everyday glenoid solution to manage a range of glenoid deformities.

text.text:
With Shoulder iD, 

you are in the driver’s seat

With Shoulder iD, surgeons can visualize, plan and order their patients’ unique glenoid implants directly through the Blueprint planning software. The technology utilizes a CT scan, surgeon-driven planning, 3D-printed implants, and patient-specific instrumentation.

Multiple studies have shown that using 3D pre-operative planning software like Blueprint and patient-specific instrumentation enable the surgeon to accurately position the glenoid implant and replicate the pre-operative surgical plan compared to standard techniques.1-4

Personalized with Shoulder iD
We’re making our Primary Reversed glenoid implants more patient specific than they’ve been before. Part of the iD Solutions family, Shoulder iD utilizes Blueprint 3D Planning Software to drive autonomous visualization, planning and order placement.
